title: GPT100 Shuttles — official
claims: The Halls Gap shuttle pick-up and drop-off point is the bus stop outside Centenary Hall at 115 Grampians Rd, Halls Gap VIC 3381.
Shuttle seats to the Mt Zero start must be booked on Race Roster; Miler, Stage Race and Team Relay runners can book free, while GPT50k runners and spectators pay A$35.
Stage Race and Team Relay runners have rolling shuttles back to Halls Gap from the Mt William, Griffin Fireline and Dunkeld finishes; these return shuttles do not need booking.
The official page says Stage 2 starts in Halls Gap and needs no shuttle.
